In this role, you will leverage your skills and interest in large language models, software engineering, and data science to analyze large-scale health data sets, contribute to the development of chatbots and predictive AI model, and support ongoing projects focused on integrating health data across various jurisdictions. This is a hands-on role ideal for a student looking to gain practical experience at the intersection of data science, healthcare, and artificial intelligence. Key Responsibilities MOSAIC Chatbot Development: Lead the end-to-end development of a conversational AI for the MOSAIC project. This includes prompt engineering, integrating LLMs with local knowledge bases (RAG), and refining the UI/UX for users. Clinical Trial Optimization: Develop and validate models to improve clinical trial workflows, such as automating patient pre- screening or predicting recruitment bottlenecks. Data Pipeline Support: Assist in building secure data pipelines to ingest, clean, and de-identify sensitive clinical data for model training. Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with clinical researchers to gather requirements for the MOSAIC chatbot, ensuring the tool meets real-world medical accuracy and usability standards. Technical Documentation: Maintain rigorous documentation of code, model performance, and data governance protocols to ensure all AI tools are audit-ready and scalable. Job Requirements Qualifications Education: Currently enrolled in a Co-op program in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow). Hands-on experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Models (LLMs). Familiarity with chatbot frameworks or vector databases (e.g., Dify, Pinecone, Chroma, LangChain) is highly desirable. Basic understanding of cloud environments (Azure/AWS) and version control (Git). Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical AI concepts to medical professionals. Strong analytical thinking and a passion for solving complex problems in the healthcare sector. High level of integrity regarding data privacy and patient confidentiality.
